reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but copies the Akahu downloader and the local clearing operation from unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The change duplicates two substantial existing blocks and repeats validation in every provider adapter and again in the shared linking function.

placement.why: Provider transport, configuration, types and linking remain in their established modules, although validation orchestration is spread between adapters and the shared linking function.

scope.why: All edits directly support the four requested linking and Fintegra changes.

maintainability.why: Shared linking remains useful, but duplicated download and unlink logic, repeated checks and an assertion that also returns replacement candidates increase maintenance overhead.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts linkBankSyncAccount reproduces unlinkAccount's local field-clearing operation instead of extracting a shared local unlink primitive that both operations can use.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions reproduces downloadAkahuTransactions with provider names changed and the response mapping reshaped into a const initializer.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared linking parameters gain replaceExistingLink; assertBankAccountNotLinked adds branches for an upgrade target, its closed state and conflicting holders without replacement; all six provider adapters still route through shared validation and linking.
